selectedOriginals.inspection: Full selected2013perspective-corrected original individually inspected. Own Tribune isGothictower, not neighboringWrigley. Repeated recessed narrow windows/dark spandrels/raised vertical limestone piers, continuous mainshaft and shallow chamfered corners; deep inset rectangular base windows/pointed main portal, elaborate two-story lower tracery/pinnacles. Crown real open arch spans between outer buttress piers and stepped central octagonal tower, open Gothic rails/crockets/caps. OldWGN/advertising/signage and streetobjects excluded.

additionalInspected.caption: Tribune Tower on June 30th 2021, with noticeable additions due to the conversion of it becoming primarily a condo building.
additionalInspected.inspection: Full2021-07-30aerial individually inspected: east rear view of historic Gothic tower centered, broad straight faces with chamfered window corners, strong vertical limestone piers/dark spandrels/blue-grey glazing. Central crown stepped inward with round-arched upper windows and open flying buttresses at eight outer piers, Gothic parapets/pinnacles/flagpole. New courtyard/roof additions/Radio andTV/printingplant wings belong to separately excluded complex. Left distant clock tower isWrigley, right golden domeInterContinental, neither this asset.

additionalInspected.inspection: Full2009straightened original individually inspected. Confirms eight-sided chamfered shaft, high round-arched paired-light heads, taller inner and shorter outer crown piers/flying arches/pierced balustrades. Low mainportal and bronze/glazed base; neighboringInterContinentalgoldendome and lowerRadio/TV complex excluded. Warm sunset color not baked into material.

additionalInspected.caption: Tribune Tower
additionalInspected.inspection: Full local upper-crown detail individually inspected. Direct control on real curved flying buttress intrados/open blue-sky void below, narrower upper trefoil counters in spans, clustered projecting stone piers/ribs/pinnacles, small abstract gargoyles, high rounded arches with recessed opaque glazing and metal mullions. Octagonal central crown has open diamond/curving Gothic rail counters, low flat roof with rail/pinnacles and flagpole, no invented Gothicspire. Fine carvings/antennas/flagcloth not duplicated.

additionalInspected.caption: Tribune Tower Wall.  The window has a mock-up of the ivy at Wrigley Field with a poster advertising the Chicago Cubs baseball games on 720 WGN.  Tribune, owners of WGN, also owned the Cubs and Wrigley Field until 2009.  Surrounding the window (clockwise from the top) are pieces of Wartburg,  Nidaros (Trondheim) Cathedral, The Alamo, Edinburgh Castle, and Westminster Abbey.
additionalInspected.inspection: Full2007ground-window detail individually inspected: bronze/green framed inset glazed window, carved four-bay foliate arch surround, deeply jointed Indiana limestone and differently colored/shaped embedded historic fragments. Model uses original simplified carving/fragment patches, no copied inscriptions/display advertisement or claimed exact fragment census.
